fields.description: Marina Views is a three-tower apartment collection at Rashid Yachts & Marina. A landscaped podium connects the buildings, with pools, fitness spaces and ground-level retail shaping daily life around the marina. The detailed plans cover one- to four-bedroom homes, including larger upper-floor layouts with separate study and family spaces.

sources.label: Emaar launch fact sheet, Mitchell’s-hosted copy
Emaar launch payment plan, Mitchell’s-hosted copy

overview: The brochure positions Marina Views between the older waterfront districts and central Dubai. Its homes range from compact one-bedroom layouts to substantially larger four-bedroom apartments. Views depend on tower, floor and orientation; marina-facing marketing imagery should not be treated as a promise for every home.
research.locationNote: Marina Views is in Rashid Yachts & Marina, Mina Rashid. Emaar references the QE2 Hotel and access towards Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. The marina, promenade and wider community facilities should be assessed alongside the project’s own residential amenities.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s headline is AED 1.65m. The launch sheet lists one-bedroom homes from AED 1.65m, two-bedroom from AED 2.52m, three-bedroom from AED 4.30m and four-bedroom from AED 9.10m. These are historical category starts, not current offers or available inventory.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan allocates 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at completion. Several later dates are linked to construction milestones. Property Finder corroborates 10/70/20; confirm purchase-specific terms before relying on this historical schedule.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates December 2028 completion. Property Finder also reports Q4 2028. The contractual date and current construction position require building-specific confirmation.

facts.label: Launch composition
facts.value: 249 one-bedroom, 175 two-bedroom, 107 three-bedroom and 14 four-bedroom homes: 545 apartments in the launch sheet. This is not remaining stock.

facts.label: Larger upper-floor layout
facts.value: Tower 1 four-bedroom Type A is shown on levels 19–20. The plan includes a study, laundry and multiple balconies; its 2,976.76 sq ft total includes 374.80 sq ft of balconies.

facts.label: Compare outdoor and indoor areas
facts.value: Apartment totals include balconies or terraces. The tower-specific ranges matter: Tower 2’s largest two-bedroom plan is substantially larger than its standard layouts.

unresolved: Emaar’s live key-facts panel says one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom penthouses. Its brochure and detailed plans instead document one- to four-bedroom apartments. Four-bedroom plans are retained; an unverified penthouse category is not added.
The launch fact table is headed ‘Villas’ despite its apartment descriptions and tower plans. Its category counts and prices are attributed to the launch sheet, not used to create a villa category.
Current availability, parking allocations, service charges, final specifications and contractual delivery require confirmation.
Images remain illustrative; project photography is deferred.
